user_prompt: We need to automatically map and consolidate sustainability data from our disparate ERP, HR, and facility management systems into a single staging area so our sustainability team can validate completeness and consistency before submitting our annual GRI and CSRD reports—right now they're manually pulling CSVs from five different systems and spending weeks reconciling conflicting numbers on energy use and headcount metrics.

steps.step_name: Build an automated data integration pipeline that consolidates sustainability data from our disparate ERP, HR, and facility management systems into a single staging area

anchors.reason: Pipeline integrates employee data (HR), facility/machine data (operations), and sustainability-relevant materials and hazardous substances across ERP, HR, and facility management systems.

The activity requires building a data integration pipeline that consolidates sustainability data from ERP, HR, and facility management systems into a staging area. This is a data ingestion and ETL orchestration task.

None of the candidates provide this capability:
- The ITSM agents (AccessProvisioning, AssetProvisioning, ChangeAutomation, ChangeRelease) focus on IT operations workflows, not data integration
- The Emarsys agents/dataProducts are product lifecycle and inventory-focused, not sustainability data consolidation
- The BOM Compliance Validator handles validation, not data pipeline orchestration

The graph walk surfaced these results due to topical overlap around "orchestration" and "consolidation," but none actually fulfill the core requirement of building ETL pipelines for sustainability data aggregation from multiple source systems.

- The agents (AccessProvisioningOrchestrator, AssetProvisioningOrchestrator, ChangeAutomationOrchestrator, ChangeReleaseCoordinator, ProductLifecycleOrchestrator, BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator) are all focused on IT/asset/change/product lifecycle management — not sustainability reporting or compliance submission generation.
